note: Hebrew re'emim are wild oxen (aurochs); the KJV follows the LXX monokeros.

kjv: the screech owl also shall rest there
note: Hebrew lilit is Lilith, a known Mesopotamian night demon (lilitu); the KJV's "screech owl" (Vulgate lamia) hides a mythological reference. The same verse has se'ir "satyr" for the goat (cf. 13:21).
